question: For $A=\begin{bmatrix}1&k&2\\3&4&0\\2&1&5\end{bmatrix}$, find $k$ if the cofactors $A_{12}$ and $A_{21}$ are equal. Verify the result.
explanation:
Calculation of $A_{12}$
Deleting the first row and second column gives $$M_{12}=\begin{vmatrix}3&0\\2&5\end{vmatrix}=15$$ Since $1+2$ is odd, $$A_{12}=-15$$
Calculation of $A_{21}$
Deleting the second row and first column gives $$M_{21}=\begin{vmatrix}k&2\\1&5\end{vmatrix}=5k-2$$ Since $2+1$ is odd, $$A_{21}=-(5k-2)=2-5k$$
Equality of the cofactors
Using $A_{12}=A_{21}$, $$-15=2-5k$$ Hence, $$k=\frac{17}{5}$$
Verification
For $k=\frac{17}{5}$, $A_{21}=2-17=-15=A_{12}$.
